g.text: Multitask SFT: decision, localization, and prompt consistency
Fixed validation sources | final update 192 | 1,536 matched source exposures per arm | one seed
Pointwise source-bootstrap intervals where available; localization denominator: all 60 anomalies.
Prompt agreement retains all 120 sources: any invalid prediction is separate. Agreement does not imply correctness.
